Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo and 33% If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down.

We've got contact inside the Void. I thought this place was supposed to be empty?
What? We've been sending research drones into the Void Rifts for months without encountering anything! Hold on. We're setting up the portal now.
Come on, V! We need a way out now. Engineer, we're heading back.
I'm not sure we can do that. They've already cut off our exit.
Commander, I've set up our ground sensors. V also has Hacker's drones flying in from The Gate.
There are some aerial enemies heading your way!
The ground sensors have also picked up on something too. I'm not seeing them.
It was explained to me by Narrator that the Void is hidden in the depths of the Nil Zone in a place far out of Two X's reach.
We're trying! There's something disrupting the link! From these metrics, it's like the portal is being absorbed before it can even form behind you. I'm tracking the energy drift patterns now!
We haven't had time to set up our defenses!
Not good. Really not good. V, find us a way out now!
It's too late to run, V. I don't know whose attention we've caught, but it doesn't look like it's going to let us leave.
Commander, readings are showing more hidden enemies heading this way!
Find a way through that armor!
So it was you. The ones who freed him. And the ones who freed us from the eons my army has slumbered. And the ones who cut the roots of a false ruler.
Keep your head down and watch for the hammer! V, what's going on here? Answer me!
*Laughter.* Do you hear it? Whispering to you. I do. And it says you will know peace in an everlasting silence.
Something's affecting The Gate! Energy density is condensing into a central point and being pulled inward! The Void is collapsing in on itself, and the structure is barely holding!
Argh! Watch out for the shockwaves!
We're barely holding on. I'm not sure we can go much longer like this...
Hold on! We're getting out of this one way or another. Hold our defenses! They won't get past us!

Why? Why do you fight so hard to leave? There's nothing out there that the silence will not reach eventually. Little by little we tear at the seams of your realms, and slowly we watch as they embrace The Void.
Our world is not for you to destroy! You won't-... no. No! Why are there two bosses?!
Try as the Guardian did to destroy it, we of The Void always have, and always will be... Waiting.
We stabilized The Gate for now, but it won't hold. We're actively searching for this girl's voice, but it's coming up scattered. It's like she's nowhere but everywhere all at once.
Well it's either her or us. I need a way to make sure it's not us. We're running out of options here.
Whatever this thing is, it's barely taking any damage! Wait, did you see that? Right as it uses an attack?
Dodge the attack and shoot it before it recovers, quick!
Where are these souls coming from?
Did you really believe your realm was the first to find silence? *Laughter.*
We're picking up significant cumulative energy nearby. Our sensors can barely track how much is being pulled in and then it's just... vanishing.
The team isn't going to make it much longer. We need a plan B. V, you need to promise me. If we don't make it, that gate closes with or without us.
Just make it out alive, okay?
What is that? Everyone get back! Engie? Engineer! V, it's taking Engineer's soul! I need everyone focusing fire on that monster!
We are freeing them of their burden. To drag them back to flesh and suffering? Only your kind would call that mercy.
*Cough*... If that happens to me again, please kill it quicker. That just felt... wrong.
I need a status update, V!
The Gate is turning into scrap metal and more Void Rifts are popping up. We need to finish whatever 'this' is and leave!
Take cover before it slices us in half! I want all guns on the target now!
The time is upon us. Now, the Void will call out to you. And it will be best to listen as you soon rest your head in a bed of flowers.
When the Old World still drew breath, Lord Exo saw what I was, what I have been always been, and accepted it.
My army marched beneath his banner as I gave him a promise that the flora of the Void would take root in every realm and bloom, until there was nothing left to bloom upon.
Now you will watch as your world dies a quiet, tranquil death.
No. We won't. Because we aren't giving you the chance.
Hah. You carry the will of a fool.
